summary.value: Also known as Messenger, Runner, Scout.

system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Inventory Points — activated.

(House note: printed FREE BENEFITS from Courier (Fabula Ultima Stuff/Courier-fabula-ultima-class.pdf, p.2 (COURIER FREE BENEFITS box)) — FU auto-applies the class math; the mechanical fields are activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise.)

COURIER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000078]{Delivery} 【Max SL 1】

Once per non-conflict scene in a populated place, pick up a package (carry up to five; lost only through Surrender), establishing where and/or to whom it goes. On delivery choose: 1 Fabula Point, (level × 10) zenit, or gain/strengthen a Bond with an NPC, location or organization relevant to the delivery.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000079]{Survey} 【Max SL 5】

On a rest, forgo normal restoration — regain only (SL × 10) HP and MP and recover from (SL) statuses (Bond adjustment keeps) — to choose an area within one travel day (further if your travel means reach further): reroll its next travel die; ask one honestly-answered question; or pick up/deliver a package there.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000080]{Spry and Tireless} 【Max SL 2】

While carrying two or fewer packages, move one extra travel day's distance on the world map. While carrying three or more, treat your maximum HP and MP as (SL × 5) higher.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000081]{Frequent Guest} 【Max SL 5】

Travel and rest services cost (SL × 10) zenit less for you and your group, to a minimum of half price. After a rest or travel roll using such a paid service, +(SL) on your next Check. Counts toward the two-effect cap.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000082]{Just Borrowing It} 【Max SL 4】

When you pick up a package, spend 1 Fabula Point to declare it rare equipment you can equip, chosen by the GM, worth up to ((level + SL) × 50) zenit. Only you may equip it; one package at a time; the loan ends on delivery. Never a hoplosphere or sphere-bearing gear.
